title: Derby on a tidal sea stack

tokens.v: Wedge it toe-up in the rock cleft the instant a swell detonates against the stack behind — a curtain of spray thrown across the gap, frozen at 1/2000, single droplets hanging, a last sheet of seawater draining off the welt stitching. 100mm at f/4, camera dropped to rock level a forearm away so leather grain and welt fill two-thirds of the frame. A barnacled rock shoulder blurs across the near-left foreground, cut by the left and bottom edges. A shallow unlettered maker's deboss runs into the rubber sole sidewall, seawater standing in the impression.
